QuestInfo.name: Expert's Heart
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2040050##k, who wanders Maple World, should know a thing or two about Diligence. Go see #p2040050#.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2040050# explains that you need a good mental attitude to make a good product. He wants you to bring some materials to prove you have an #t1142276#. Gather the materials #p2040050# asks for.

#i2000004# #t2000004# #b#c2000004# / 10#k
#i2000005# #t2000005# #b#c2000005# / 10#k

0.0: Hello, #h0#. What can I do for you...? Oh? You want to know how Diligent I am? Well, there's always room for improvement, but I'm not bad. More than anything, I always strive to improve myself.
0.1: When I started my nomadic life, I made an important decision. I chose to never forget the attitude I had when I frst started crafting items. If you have the right attitude, Diligence is sure to follow. Why don't I give you a little lesson?

yes.0: You need a few ingredients to create an #t1142276#. #b#t2000004#s#k and #b#t2000005#s#k... Please bring me #b10 of each#k.

no.0: Hmm...I suppose not everyone values Diligence.

1.0: Oh, you've gathered all the ingredients. Now, I'll start making the #t1142276#. Give me a moment.

yes.0: Here's the #t1142276#... What? Of course it's a medal! You didn't think I was making an actual heart, did you? Anyway, the #t1142276# medal will give you an #t1142276# just by equipping it! Enjoy!

item.0: Have you not been able to obtain the #b#t2000004#s#k and #b#t2000005#s#k? Hmm...they aren't easy to find, are they?
